name: Pope Pius XII
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 1939 to 1958
contribution: Head of the Catholic Church and sovereign of the Vatican City from 2 March 1939 until his death in 1958.
legacy: He explicitly invoked ex cathedra papal infallibility with the dogma of the Assumption of Mary in his Apostolic constitution Munificentissimus Deus.

checks.lead: Pope Pius XII (Italian: Pio XII; born Eugenio Maria Giuseppe Giovanni Pacelli; 2 March 1876 – 9 October 1958) was head of the Catholic Church and sovereign of the Vatican City from 2 March 1939 until his death in 1958. His pontificate spanned World War II, the Holocaust, and the first years of the Cold War. He is the most recent Pope to take the name Pius.
